mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Firemans Park with an air quality index of 55, a third quarter moon, and an overnight low of 52 degrees with no rain predicted. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Public Works Department handles refuse and recycling through Pellitteri Waste Systems. Weekly refuse and biweekly recycling are provided for residential properties, and you can utilize the Waste Wizard tool on the city website to determine proper disposal for various household items.

There is a busy schedule of events ahead, starting with live music at Baileys Run Vineyard today. Looking forward, we have yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, followed by a full slate of trivia and entertainment at local favorites like Hop Haus, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company throughout the week.

In a report covering October 18 through October 24, officers responded to various calls, including an incident on October 21 where police assisted emergency services at a residence on Basswood Avenue for a cardiac arrest.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The shop is currently open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
